youtube.title: What the Square on Your Toothpaste Tube Really Means 🪥 #Shorts
youtube.description:
The small coloured square at the end of a toothpaste tube is an eye mark (registration mark). Tubes are filled through the open end on high-speed machines, and a light sensor reads the mark to orient each tube before it's folded, cut and sealed. The viral claim that green means natural and black means chemical is a myth.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.

#Shorts #science #facts #thehiddenwhy

sources: Snopes: toothpaste tube colour codes (eye marks) do not indicate ingredients; they are for sensor alignment during manufacture
Packaging industry: registration/eye marks read by photoelectric sensors on tube filling and sealing machines
